<subject>Re: Investment Committee meeting follow up</subject>
<body>
Great idea.  

My key points would be that (a) the SEC needs to push ahead with its "risk-based" audits and (b) focus on standardizing the due diligence and portfolio management [no more collaborative efforts].  Two simple, easy to understand thoughts.  

Also, I think that it's a mistake to use the term "large portfolios".  We don't want large portfolios.  We want portfolios that cover natural markets and benefit investors.

Preston Andrade, Principal
Cedar Point Capital Partners
phone: 704-012-3456
</body>
